conversation.text: Hi, I need to file a warranty claim. The unit you installed last year stopped working.
To file a warranty claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).

A unit installed last year is within the 2-year labor warranty that Meridian provides on full system installations, and Comfort Club members at the time of installation receive a 5-year labor warranty instead (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand, and they cover the part only (Warranty Policy, Manufacturer parts warranty).
